purpose: Evaluate an actual 10-15 minute user-provided MP4 on the target Android APP process using current T09 AndroidMediaSource inspect and decodePcm. Do NOT claim full T11-T14 processing pipeline or E2E.

source_conditions.real user video: MP4 containing actual video track and audio track; no WAV loop substitutes
source_conditions.duration seconds: 600-900 inclusive from AndroidMediaSource inspector, no reliance on filename
source_conditions.locality: Host video stays on user's Windows machine and is temporarily staged in app-specific external storage; staged device copy deleted after run; source content not committed.
source_conditions.offline: ADB preflight requires airplane_mode_on=1 and wifi_on=0, no network calls in benchmark; OS / radio logs not independently attested
source_conditions.device_temperature: Battery sensor must report <40C initially; stop when >=43C. Proxy, not CPU die temperature.

metrics: SHA256 host video and pre-/post-decoding device input equality
video duration and dimensions/rotation/codec, audio track MIME
audio PCM bytes and chunks, first/last PTS, sample format/rate/channels
inspect wall time, decode wall time, total wall time, derived decode real-time factor
sampled Android process PSS and sampled Java heap, not actual allocation peaks
battery start, end and maximum sampled temperature, not SoC temperature
instrumentation exit and failure JSON for any nonfatal exception

diagnostic_success_criteria.video: 600-900 seconds with genuine audio + video tracks
diagnostic_success_criteria.decode: >0 PCM chunks/bytes, not truncated, final PCM PTS within 5s of video duration
diagnostic_success_criteria.source: host SHA = device SHA before and after
diagnostic_success_criteria.runtime: callback wall-clock guard at 20 minutes and host watchdog at 25 minutes

prerequisites_not_done: Physical Sony run on an actual video, receiving device result JSON
Full ASR/translation/timing/render/export pipeline for 10-minute MP4: T11-T14 not implemented
New ASR WER <20% and translation ID->EN >=27/30 official gate

prior_evidence.paragraph_strategy: whole 43/60 ACCEPT vs linewise 43/60; linewise rejected

risk_note: A media-stage PASS reduces ingestion/decoding risk only. It must never be conflated with 10-minute real APP end-to-end subtitle creation or thermal/RAM ASR measurements.
